explication: Proxima is a local AI gateway for editor and desktop clients, with browser-session routing and BYOK/local-model routing. A typical request enters through its MCP server, is routed and enriched, then reaches a provider; the MCP pipeline also tracks usage and request state. The repository additionally contains a Python self-healing agent with computer/coding tools, cross-session memory, and a web interface. The README documents these capabilities; source excerpts and the SOURCE INDEX support only some internal call edges, so other links are omitted rather than inferred.
